facts.business: Hindustan Agrigenetics Limited is engaged in the seed business, specifically agriculture seeds, and is exploring opportunities in agri and other sectors.
key_risks: Dependence on monsoon affecting sowing patterns and seed demand
High entry barriers in seed industry dominated by proprietary brands
Pest resistance to BT genes in GM seeds
Declining cotton prices reducing cotton sowing area
Opposition to genetically modified seeds from environmental groups and scientists
facts.related_party_note: The Company has made proper disclosures in financial statements in respect of Related Party Transactions as per applicable Accounting Standards and SEBI LODR Regulations.
